title: くらい vs ほど
summary: Both give an extent, but ほど stresses a large degree and くらい is approximate or small.

blocks.text: **くらい** (also ぐらい) and **ほど** are nouns of extent: they say how much, how far, how long. The difference is in the size they suggest.

rows: a large degree, an upper limit

blocks.jp: これほど難しいとは思わなかった。
blocks.en: I didn't think it was this difficult.
I can't run as fast as he can.
I laughed so hard that tears came.

blocks.text: ほど is also the upper side of a comparison: the thing in front of ほど has the larger amount.
くらい: about, or at least

blocks.jp: 駅まで十分ぐらいかかる。
blocks.en: It takes about ten minutes to the station.

blocks.jp: 一言くらい謝ってほしい。
blocks.en: I want at least a word of apology.

blocks.text: When くらい marks something small, it often means "at least", often with a complaint.

items: **ほど** = a great extent; negative: not that much.
**くらい** = about; or "at least" when small.
これくらい = about this much; これほど = this much (a lot).

questions.instruction: Which word suggests a large degree?
questions.note: ほど points at the upper limit.

questions.instruction: Which word is used for "about ten minutes"?
questions.note: Approximation.

questions.instruction: Which sentence uses ほど for comparison?
options: 私は彼ほど背が高くない。
questions.note: The larger one comes before ほど.

questions.prompt: ほど suggests a small amount.
questions.note: It suggests a large degree.

questions.prompt: ぐらい is another sound of くらい.
questions.note: It's the same word.
questions.en: ぐらい is another form of くらい (about).

questions.instruction: What does どのくらいかかりますか ask?
options: About how long or how much does it take
questions.note: It asks softly for an estimate.

questions.prompt: せめて「ありがとう」＿＿言ってください。
questions.note: Small thing + くらい means at least.
ほど marks the larger side of a comparison: not as hot as yesterday.
questions.en: Today isn't as hot as yesterday.

questions.prompt: 宿題はそれほど難しくなかった。
questions.note: ほど with a negative means not that much.

questions.instruction: What does くらい mean here?
questions.prompt: 一度くらい行ってみたい。
questions.note: くらい after a small amount means at least.
questions.en: I'd like to go at least once.

questions.instruction: Which sentence says I can't sing as well as my sister?
options: 私は姉に上手に歌えない。
私は姉ほど上手に歌えない。
私は姉ばかり上手に歌えない。
私は姉だけ上手に歌えた。
questions.note: ほど + negative: not as much as.

questions.instruction: Which sentence says "It was so cold that my hands hurt"?
options: 寒くて手が痛くなるまでだった。
寒くて手が痛くなるしかなかった。
寒くて手が痛くなるほどだった。
寒くて手が痛くなるだけだった。
questions.note: ほど shows a large degree.

questions.instruction: Tap the word that gives the approximate amount
questions.note: ぐらい means about.
questions.en: It takes about twenty minutes by bus.

questions.instruction: Tap the word that marks the larger side of the comparison
questions.note: 彼女ほど: nobody is as kind as she is.
questions.en: There is nobody as kind as she is.

questions.note: ぐらい after a small thing means at least.
Amount + ぐらい: about.

questions.prompt: I can't run as fast as my brother.
questions.note: ほど + negative.
questions.en: I can't run as fast as my brother.

questions.prompt: I want you to at least call me.
questions.note: くらい: at least, with a mild complaint.
questions.en: I want you to at least call me.

questions.prompt: I was so hungry I couldn't walk.
questions.note: Clause + ほど: to the extent that.
questions.en: I was so hungry I couldn't walk.

questions.prompt: これくらい means "about this much", and これほど means "this much (a lot)".
questions.note: くらい is approximate; ほど is a large degree.
questions.en: About this much / this much (a lot).

questions.prompt: 彼ほど料理が上手な人はいない means that he is not good at cooking.
questions.note: It means nobody is as good at cooking as he is.
questions.en: There is nobody as good at cooking as he is.
